title: Persona Rapper Lotus Juice Attends Japan Habba Bengaluru Event on January 10
content:
Lotus Juice has provided music for much of the Persona game and anime series, including the theme songs for Persona 3 the Movie #2 Midsummer Knight's Dream , Persona 3 the Movie #3 Falling Down , Persona 4 The Animation , Persona -trinity soul- , Persona 3 , Persona 3 Fes, Persona 3 Portable , and Persona 2 OP . He has also provided music for anime including JoJo's Bizarre Adventure , Soul Eater , Noragami , The irregular at magic high school , Black Butler , and Bungo Stray Dogs , among others.

The staff describes the event:

Since its inception in 2005, Japan Habba has been at the forefront of promoting Indo-Japanese cultural exchange. The event serves as a platform for enthusiasts to experience the essence of Japan and connect with like-minded individuals.

The Japan Habba 2025 event took place on January 12 and hosted controversial mascot character Chiitan, a Hello Kitty mascot, idol group Nanometer, musical ensemble Ryoma Quartet, and musician Kanapon. The event also included anime screenings, a manga workshop, "Light Novel Title Mad Libs," a karaoke competition, yukata wearing activity, a Japanese cinema seminar, as well as several Japanese food stalls. The cosplay events included a cosplay showcase, a " cosplay chess" event, and a dedicated gaming tournament for cosplayers .

The 2023 event hosted a Tech & Jobs Fair on May 13 and a Cultural Festival on May 14 at the National Science Seminar Complex and Satish Dhawan Auditorium, Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru. It hosted a seminar titled "The Greatest Artistic Movement in Anime," which spoke of the moe movement and drew on the works of Patrick Galbraith and Eiji Ootsuka. The Animathon quiz had over 200 participants and team "Cardcaptor Sakuga" won the grand prize. Finalists in the quiz won Bocchi the Rock! keychains. The Cultural Festival also had a cosplay showcase, Pokémon Go event, and Smash Bros Ultimate tournament. Tomokuni Terukina, "a sanshin master of the Afuso-ryu school," performed on stage on May 14. The event featured stalls selling anime and manga merchandise as well as activities involving tea ceremony, calligraphy, ikebana, and origami, and traditional Japanese food.
author: ANN

title: Tickets Still Available For Naoko Yamada Masterclass on Saturday in Kilkenny City, Ireland
content:
The schedule of events is as followed - tickets are available for the separate events here . All of the events listed below will be at the Watergate Theatre, except for the "We'll Dub It Live!" show on Saturday.

Friday

10 p.m. - Late night screening of Satoshi Kon 's Perfect Blue , introduced by the director Tomm Moore of the animation studio Cartoon Saloon .

Saturday

10 a.m. - Screening of The Colors Within , introduced by the film's director Naoko Yamada

1 p.m. - 90-minute director masterclass with Naoko Yamada . The event is described as follows: " Naoko Yamada shares insights into her creative process, artistic influences and her approach to storytelling through animation. Featuring film clips, discussion and audience engagement, with translation throughout."

3 p.m. - "We'll Dub it Live! - Ferg & Stephen Take on Anime" - This 60-minute event will take place at Home Rule Club. Described as "a gloriously chaotic comedy show celebrating the art of getting lost in translation. Created and hosted by Fergal Brennan and Stephen Colfer, inspired by questionable anime dubs, this interactive performance takes a beloved anime scene and throws the original script out the window."

5.30 p.m. - Screening of A Silent Voice , introduced by the film's director Naoko Yamada

Sunday

12 noon - Anime's Journey to the West – An Illustrated Talk by Helen McCarthy (60 minutes)

4 p.m. - East West Anime - A panel moderated by Andrew Partridge , Chief Content Officer of TOHO Europe, and featuring the authors Helen McCarthy and Charles Solomon , discussing "how culture, language and translation shape anime's reception across markets."

"Rich with emotion, mystery and quiet wonder, the film follows an ex-convict whose life takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a mysterious tree said to grant wishes. As the story unfolds, The Camphor Tree explores themes of redemption, regret and the choices that shape our lives in a deeply human way that has become a hallmark of contemporary anime storytelling."

Kilkenny Animated is hosted by Cartoon Saloon , Lighthouse Studios and Schweppe Curtis Nunn Events,

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime Adaptation Streams in India in January
content:
The anime will also stream on Crunchyroll worldwide, excluding Asia, with availability in Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia.

Crunchyroll describes its story:

A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches. Gongja Kim, a weak F-rank Hunter, spends his days envying the Flame Emperor who reigns as the top Hunter. But his chance at greatness finally arrives when he joins forces with the Sword Emperor and gains a rare S-rank skill, with one catch: he must die to activate it.

The cast members include:

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Gongja Kim

• Satoshi Hino as the Sword Emperor

Hiroaki Sakurai is directing the anime. Sayuri Ōba is writing the scripts. Takahiro Yoshimatsu is creating the character designs. Studio fu is in charge of animation production.

Neida 's SSS-Class Revival Hunter webtoon is based on Sinnoa and Bill K 's web novel of the same name. The webtoon launched in Kakao Page in December 2020. Tapas publishes the webtoon in English. WuxiaWorld publishes the web novel in English.

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Film Opens in Indian Theaters on January 29, 2027
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will release the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film in Indian theaters on January 29, 2027. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles as well as dubbed in English.

The film will open in India on the same date as the United States, Canada, and United Kingdom releases.

The film will feature returning cast:

• Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki

• Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Sizuki

The story of the original Witch on the Holy Night visual novel is set in the late 1980s, and centers on protagonist Aoko Aozaki, one of two sister heirs to a long family line of modern mages. Although she is disinterested in magic, she is suddenly declared as the heir of their family's magical art, and reluctantly begins her apprenticeship under Alice Kuonji, a young witch who lives in a lonely manor atop a hill. Aoko balances her duties of learning the arcane, while also serving as her school's student council president. She also makes the acquaintance of Sōjūrō Shizuki (romanized as Soujyuro Sizuki in the English version of the game), a new transfer student who is unfamiliar with much of the modern world, and contends with the plots of her older sister Tōko Aozaki, who feels that her birthright has been denied.

Type-Moon most recently released the game on Steam in December 2023.

Aniplex released the PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch version of the game in the West in December 2022, on the same day as the game's Japanese release date. The PS4 and Switch versions have sold more than 150,000 copies worldwide.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon- , the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PlayStation 4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.
author: ANN

title: Ghibli's Arrietty Will Be Released in UK and Ireland IMAX cinemas from October 14
content:
In a press release on Thursday, GKIDS has confirmed UK cinema release details for Studio Ghibli 's 2010 film Arrietty , directed by Yoshifumi Kondō . It will be released on Wednesday October 14 and 15 in IMAX cinemas in the UK and Ireland, followed by a wider cinema release from Friday October 16. Screening dates and venue details will be listed at https://www.gkids.co.uk/tickets/ .

The film will be screened in both dubbed and English-subtitled versions. The press release specifies that the English dub will be the UK (not US) dub, which includes the first film role of Tom Holland , now Spider-Man in the MCU films. The dub cast also includes Saoirse Ronan , Olivia Colman , Geraldine McEwan and Mark Strong and is featured in the trailer below.

From the press release:

"In a secret world hidden beneath the floorboards, tiny people called Borrowers live out of sight of humans. But when brave Arrietty is out gathering supplies, she is discovered by Sho, a human boy, and they begin to form a friendship that blossoms into a heartwarming adventure.

" Arrietty is a gorgeous and adventure-filled adaptation of Mary Norton 's “The Borrowers,” one of the most beloved children's books of all time, directed by Academy Award®-nominee Hiromasa Yonebayashi based on a screenplay by Hayao Miyazaki , who also worked on project planning for the film, and Keiko Niwa ."

Before the release of Arriety, GKIDS is releasing Yoshifumi Kondō 's 1995 Studio Ghibli film Whisper of the Heart , on IMAX screens from Wednesday September 16, with a wider cinema release from Friday September 18. It will be released in both English-dubbed and subtitled versions. As with Arrietty , screenings of the film are listed at https://www.gkids.co.uk/tickets/ .
author: ANN

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Delays Episodes 49 and 50 to October "to Improve Quality"
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has delayed Episode 49 and Episode 50 to October 2026 in order to “improve quality” as the anime approaches its climax. The anime previously revised the streaming schedule for numerous platforms in Japan.

Episode 49 will now air on TV Tokyo on October 19, followed by BS TV Tokyo on October 20. Streaming on various platforms will begin on October 20 as well.

Episode 50 will follow on TV Tokyo a week later on October 26and BS TV Tokyo on October 27.

The updated schedule is:

• Episode 49: October 19

• Episode 50: October 26

Until Episode 49 resumes the main story, TV Tokyo will air a BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War “Climax Selection” episodes on September 19, September 26, October 5 and October 12.

The production committee said the schedule was changed to allow additional quality improvements heading into the climax and to deliver the remaining episodes in the best possible form. The staff also apologized to viewers for the wait and said production will continue toward the conclusion of the BLEACH anime.

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High opened pre-registrations last month, with the game set to launch in 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 Features Renji Abarai Changes in Episode 8 Ending Video
content:

While the majority of the video is unchanged, there are several frames that now feature Renji Abarai. This follows the previous episodes, where Ichigo was replaced by Kisuke Urahara in Episode 2 , Orihime Inoue in Episode 3 , Rukia Kuchiki in Episode 4 , Uryu Ishida in Episode 6 , and Kyoraku Shunsui in Episode 7. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles. Hulu recently confirmed that the final part of the anime will run for 10 episodes.
On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High opened pre-registrations earlier today, with the game set to launch in 2026.

title: Netflix Announces Cast for Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Outback
content:
Netflix confirmed production on Friday of its new series Outback (working title), with Jun-Yeol Ryu, Kyung Hong, Ho-yeon Jung, Ji-an Won, and Justin H. Min set to star.

Based on the webtoon G'day by Yong Sung Choi, Outback follows Sion, who travels to Australia after his older sister's sudden death. In an unfamiliar city, he begins investigating the circumstances surrounding her death and uncovers hidden truths.

The story of the original webtoon, originally serialized between 2015 and 2017, reads:

Having lost all contact with his sister, Shiyoung, a worried Shion sets out to see what is wrong by arriving in Australia, where his sister was staying. While staying at the share house his sister was living, he starts to sense that the people there have something to do with his missing sister.

Hong will play Sion, who travels to Australia to uncover the truth behind his sister's death. Ryu will play Min-hyuk, a man at the center of the mystery Sion investigates.

Jung will portray Smiley, a creator who communicates with people through livestreams in Australia, while Won will play Sion's older sister, Si-young. Justin H. Min will portray Scott, a Korean-Australian police officer.

A release date has not yet been decided.

Fans can read the English version of the webtoon on Lehzin .

title: 31 Years Ago, This Shoujo Anime Changed The World in a Way You’d Never Expect
content:
Just about every anime fan is familiar with shoujo staples like Ai Yazawa’s Nana , or even her slightly more niche hit series Paradise Kiss , but neither of these generation-defining stories would have been made possible without the success of Neighborhood Story . While Neighborhood Story wasn’t Ai Yazawa’s debut into the manga industry , her sophomore serialized work was quickly picked up by Toei Animation to receive an anime adaptation in 1995.

Airing on September 10, 1995, Neighborhood Story followed Mikako Koda, an aspiring fashion designer locked in a heated rivalry with one of her classmates. The coming-of-age series follows the classic “boy next door trope” as Mikako begins reassessing her feelings for her childhood friend and neighbor Tsutomu after they make it to high school and he begins to become more popular due to his resemblance to a pop star.

Neighborhood Story Laid The Groundwork For Paradise Kiss And Nana

While Ai Yazawa has cemented her legacy as a shoujo mangaka with the success of Paradise Kiss and Nana , neither of those series would exist without the narrative influences of Neighborhood Story . Paradise Kiss , after all, acts as a direct sequel to Neighborhood Story , and even features frequent cameos from Mikako’s fashion brand Happy Berry. More importantly, Miwako, one of the main cast members of Paradise Kiss is the all grown-up younger sister of Mikako in Neighborhood Story . These references are incredibly charming, and while it’s not at all necessary to be familiar with Neighborhood Story to enjoy Paradise Kiss , it’s clear that the legacy of the series has let a mark on Ai Yazawa’s greater creative universe and on her characters. The same can be said about Nana , Ai Yazawa’s most popular work, which has similar callbacks to characters introduced in both of the formerly mentioned titles.

In all of Ai Yazawa’s works, fashion and tangible expressions of femininity are utilized to display character moods and the progression of their individual story arcs. Mikako’s personal narrative in Neighborhood Story set this trend in motion, as we see her creative visions being heavily effected by whatever is currently happening in her personal life. This character quirk is present in all of the characters featured throughout Yazawa’s later works, with characters like Hachi from Nana having her color palette and fashion style become more stereotypically mature and muted the longer that her circumstances begin to weigh down her emotional and mental state once she and Nana’s friendship begins falling apart.

How Neighborhood Story Left A Major Impact On Future Creatives

Despite only being on the air for one year between 1995 and 1996, Neighborhood Story has left a major impact on modern shoujo and the world beyond it. Given the series strong focus on the fashion industry, it shouldn’t be surprising that the anime influenced real-world designers like AMIAYA, a twin-sister creative duo from Japan who have worked as DJs and fashion designers who established the label “jouetie”. The pair have, in numerous interviews, cited Ai Yazawa’s Neighborhood Story as their personal style bible growing up and breaking out into the fashion industry. Similarly, Phyllis Chan and Suzzie Chung from YanYan Knits have discussed how Ai Yazawa’s complex, meticulous attention to detail when designing her characters in Neighborhood Story was unlike anything else releasing at that time and inspired them as designers to think outside the contemporary box.

Despite its massive influence, unfortunately, Neighborhood Story hasn’t found a home on a massive streaming service for fans to dive into the series that started Ai Yazawa’s interconnected shoujo universe . However, thankfully, Viz Media distributes the official English translation of the manga in both print and digital, which can be purchased through retailers like Barnes & Noble, Books-a-Million, and Amazon.
